messages:
maria: quick note 1: I'm iterating on a lightweight preflight that returns an estimated unit count so Console can surface cost before submit. prototype attached to ingress.

devon: where does the estimator live? ingress sync call to runtime? local heuristic?

maria: runtime exposes /internal/estimate. ingress calls it for preflight only. estimator takes dims, count, quant profile. nothing is used for billing until request completes.

kevin: two immediate concerns: (a) users misread estimate as final bill, (b) high-cardinality telemetry if we add too many tags.

sarah: UX: show label "Estimate" and a small "may differ from billed amount" tooltip. also show "will be split" when applicable.

henry: telemetry plan: emit aggregates to TSDB: "embeds.estimate.sum", "embeds.estimate.count". sample per-request traces at 5% with metadata: estimate_value, estimator_version, dims, items. mask any text/contents.

maria: rollout plan draft:
 - feature flag: embed_preflight_preview (canary tenants)
 - preflight endpoint: GET /v1/embeddings/preflight -> JSON { estimated_units, estimator_version, note }
 - header on preflight responses: X-Embed-Estimate: 432;v=1.2;note=split
 - Console reads header first, falls back to body for details
 - compare estimate -> billed for canary 24h; target drift <7% before expanding

devon: add an inputs checksum to trace so we can repro without storing user content. include dims+count+profile hashed.

kevin: for payload limits, if dims > 10000 or per-item > 2MB, return 413 with header X-Embed-Estimate: clipped and body note. also return a friendly SDK error explaining preflight step.

sarah: Console copy: "Estimated units (preview). Requests marked 'split' may be executed as multiple backend calls." show an info link to docs. experimental badge for canary.

ingress-bot: preflight sample for tenant canary-9: estimated_units=189 v=1.2 note=none at 3169871248

henry: operational note: store counts in TSDB on 1m rollup. traces only hold numeric metadata + checksum. DO NOT include raw user text or embeddings.

maria: I'll open PR with ingress + small Console patch + docs. will add e2e harness that simulates skewed dims and mixed small/huge batches. tagging @kevin @devon for review.

kevin: add an e2e assert: when request is split, sum of subrequest units >= preflight estimate (avoid undercounting).

devon: thumbs up. schedule canary at 02:00 UTC tomorrow low traffic window.

sarah: :rocket:
